info.title: OuterEmpires 2 Public API
info.description:
Public API for third-party tools and companion apps to access OuterEmpires 2 character data.

## Overview

This is an OAuth2-style API. The third-party application exchanges a per-character `client_id` and `secret` for a short-lived JSON Web Token (JWT). This token allows calls to the data endpoints. **Tokens are scoped to a single character** — each secret a player issues authorises exactly one of their characters, so an app that wants to read data for two characters needs two secrets.

## Identifiers

Three identifiers are involved in the auth flow:

- **`app_id`** — a GUID identifying your registered third-party application. App developers register an application with Outer Empires and receive an `app_id`. The `app_id` is used by the app to identify itself when exchanging a secret for a token and when calling data endpoints.

- **`client_id`** — the player's account identifier within OE2, this is public information and safe to share. Can be found in the API settings tab in-game.

- **`secret`** — an opaque per-character credential. The player generates the secret in-game for one of their characters and selects the scopes they wish to grant. Each secret is bound to a single character on a single account. Secrets are confidential and should be stored and transmitted with the same care as a password.

## Scopes

Scopes let the player decide exactly what data a given secret — and any token minted from it — is allowed to read. The player selects scopes when they create the secret in-game; the token issued at exchange time carries only the scopes the player approved. Each endpoint declares a required scope and rejects tokens that do not carry it, so an app can only see the slice of data the player actually consented to share.

| Scope | Grants access to |
|-------|------------------|
| `assets.locations.read` | List of locations where the character holds assets, and per-location asset breakdowns |
| `banking.balance.read` | Current banking balance |
| `banking.transactions.read` | Banking transaction history |
| `character.info.read` | Public character profile (name, corporation, etc.) |
| `character.skills.read` | Character skills and skill-in-training |
| `colony.list.read` | List of the character's colonies |
| `colony.summary.read` | Per-colony summary information |
| `colony.buildings.read` | Per-colony building list and attributes |
| `colony.warehouse.read` | Per-colony warehouse contents |
| `colony.workers.read` | Per-colony workforce information |
| `jobs.accepted.read` | Jobs the character has accepted |
| `killmail.list.read` | Kill mail summary list (kills and deaths) |
| `killmail.detail.read` | Full kill mail detail (fit, attackers, victim) |
| `mail.list.read` | In-game mail headers (inbox and sent) |
| `mail.body.read` | Body of a specific in-game mail |
| `ship.configuration.read` | Active ship fit and modules |
| `ship.cargo.read` | Active ship cargo hold contents |

## Token exchange

Exchange the secret for a JWT with a single call:

```http
POST /v1/auth/token
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "app_id": "<your registered app_id GUID>",
  "client_id": "<player's client/account id>",
  "secret": "<the per-character secret the player issued>",
  "grant_type": "client_credentials"
}
```

A successful response returns the JWT, its lifetime, the `character_id` it is bound to, and the granted scopes:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "accessToken": "eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIs...",
    "tokenType": "Bearer",
    "expiresIn": 3600,
    "characterId": 12345,
    "scopes": ["character.info.read", "character.skills.read"],
    "subscription": "standard"
  }
}
```

Tokens are short-lived (~1 hour). When a token expires, repeat the exchange with the same secret to mint a new one.

## Calling data endpoints

Every authenticated endpoint requires **two** headers:

- `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` — the JWT returned by `/v1/auth/token`.
- `X-App-Id: <app_id>` — the same `app_id` used at token exchange. The API verifies the header matches the `app_id` claim baked into the JWT; a mismatch returns `401 Unauthorized`.

The endpoint then enforces that the JWT carries the scope it requires. A missing scope returns `403 Forbidden`. All read operations act on the single character the secret was issued for — the API does not accept a character id in the request path or query.

## Errors

Every response body is wrapped in a `ServiceResponse<T>` envelope with `success`, `returnCode`, `returnString`, and `data` fields. The HTTP status code mirrors `returnCode` on error responses, and `returnString` contains a human-readable message suitable for debugging (not for end users).

get.summary: List locations where the character holds assets
get.description:
Returns the set of locations (stations, colonies, ships, etc.) where the character currently holds any assets, with a summary of what's at each. Use the `locationId` + `locationType` pair from each entry to drill into the per-location detail via `GET /v1/assets/locations/{locationId}`.

Supports optional free-text search and an item-type filter to narrow the result set.

**Required scope:** `assets.locations.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text substring search across resource, crate, and location names. Maximum 200 characters.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Item type-code filter. 1-2 character code (e.g. `R`, `C`, `S`, `Bp`, `Sh`). Omit to include all types.

200.description: Locations holding any of the character's assets, with per-location summary counts.

get.summary: Get the character's assets at a single location
get.description:
Returns the full breakdown of the character's assets at one location: resources, crates, ships, blueprints, etc. The `locationId` and `locationType` together identify the location and must be the pair returned by `GET /v1/assets/locations`.

Supports optional free-text search and an item-type filter to narrow the result set.

**Required scope:** `assets.locations.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: Id of a location returned by `GET /v1/assets/locations`. Must be paired with the matching `locationType` query parameter from the same entry — the id alone is not unique across location types.

parameters.name: locationType
parameters.description: Location type-code for the `locationId`. 1-2 character code (e.g. `St`, `Co`, `Sh`). Required — use the `locationType` value returned alongside the matching `locationId` by `GET /v1/assets/locations`.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text substring search across resource, crate, and ship names. Maximum 200 characters.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Item type-code filter. 1-2 character code (e.g. `R`, `C`, `S`, `Bp`, `Sh`). Omit to include all types.

200.description: Full asset breakdown at the requested location.

post.summary: Exchange a player-issued secret for an access token
post.description:
Exchanges an `app_id` + `client_id` + `secret` triple for a short-lived JWT access token (~1 hour). The minted token is bound to the single character the secret was issued for, and carries only the scopes the player approved when they created the secret.

This endpoint is anonymous — callers do not yet have a token. The response includes the `characterId` so the caller knows which character the token applies to, and the `scopes` array so the caller knows which endpoints it can call.

When the token expires, repeat this exchange with the same secret to mint a new one.

200.description: Token successfully minted. The `accessToken` should be sent in the `Authorization: Bearer ...` header on subsequent requests.

get.summary: Get the character's current banking balance
get.description:
Returns the character's current banking balance.

**Required scope:** `banking.balance.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

200.description: Current banking balance for the character.

get.description:
Returns a paged, optionally date-filtered list of banking transactions (credits and debits) for the character, newest first.

**Required scope:** `banking.transactions.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based pagination offset. Must be 0 or greater. Default 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Must be between 50 and 250 inclusive. Default 50.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Return only transactions on or after this date/time. ISO 8601 (e.g. `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`). Optional.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Return only transactions on or before this date/time. ISO 8601. Must be on or after `dateFrom` if both are supplied. Optional.

200.description: Paged list of banking transactions, newest first.

get.description:
Returns the basic profile of the character.

**Required scope:** `character.info.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

get.summary: Get the character's trained skills and skill-in-training
get.description:
Returns the list of skills the character has trained (with current level) and the skill currently being trained (with progress and completion time, if any).

**Required scope:** `character.skills.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

200.description: Trained skills and the skill currently in training.

get.description:
Returns the set of colonies the character owns, with enough summary information to choose one to drill into. Use each entry's `id` as the `colonyId` for the per-colony endpoints under `/v1/colonies/{colonyId}`.

**Required scope:** `colony.list.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

get.summary: Get summary information for a single colony
get.description:
Returns headline information for one of the character's colonies: name, location, capacities, durability, modifiers, recent notices, and workforce overview.

**Colony requirement:** the colony must have a Remote Operations Array building installed and online — without one the colony cannot be queried remotely and the call will fail.

**Required scope:** `colony.summary.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

parameters.name: colonyId
parameters.description: Id of one of the character's colonies. Use the `id` of any entry returned by `GET /v1/colonies`. Requesting a colony the character does not own returns 404.

200.description: Summary information for the requested colony.

get.summary: List buildings at a single colony
get.description:
Returns the list of buildings present at a colony, including each building's level, status, and attributes (production rates, capacities, etc.).

**Colony requirement:** the colony must have a Remote Operations Array building installed and online — without one the colony cannot be queried remotely and the call will fail.

**Required scope:** `colony.buildings.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

parameters.name: colonyId
parameters.description: Id of one of the character's colonies. Use the `id` of any entry returned by `GET /v1/colonies`. Requesting a colony the character does not own returns 404.

200.description: Buildings at the requested colony with their levels, statuses, and attributes.

get.summary: Get warehouse contents for a single colony
get.description:
Returns the contents of the colony's warehouse: resources, components, and other stored items, with quantities.

**Colony requirement:** the colony must have a Remote Operations Array building installed and online — without one the colony cannot be queried remotely and the call will fail.

**Required scope:** `colony.warehouse.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

parameters.name: colonyId
parameters.description: Id of one of the character's colonies. Use the `id` of any entry returned by `GET /v1/colonies`. Requesting a colony the character does not own returns 404.

200.description: Warehouse contents at the requested colony.

get.summary: Get workforce information for a single colony
get.description:
Returns workforce information for a colony: worker counts by class, assignments, happiness, and any other workforce-related state.

**Colony requirement:** the colony must have a Remote Operations Array building installed and online — without one the colony cannot be queried remotely and the call will fail.

**Required scope:** `colony.workers.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

parameters.name: colonyId
parameters.description: Id of one of the character's colonies. Use the `id` of any entry returned by `GET /v1/colonies`. Requesting a colony the character does not own returns 404.

200.description: Workforce information at the requested colony.

get.summary: List jobs the character has accepted
get.description:
Returns the jobs the character has currently accepted but not yet completed, with each job's source, reward, deadline, and progress.

**Required scope:** `jobs.accepted.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

200.description: Jobs the character has accepted and not yet completed.

get.description:
Returns a paged summary list of the character's kill mails (both kills and deaths), newest first. Each entry contains enough information to display a feed row; use `GET /v1/killmails/{killMailId}` for the full mail.

Supports filters to include kills only, deaths only, or restrict to PvP/PvE engagements.

**Required scope:** `killmail.list.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

parameters.name: kills
parameters.description: Include mails where the character was an attacker. Default `true`. At least one of `kills` or `deaths` must be `true`.

parameters.name: deaths
parameters.description: Include mails where the character was the victim. Default `true`. At least one of `kills` or `deaths` must be `true`.

parameters.name: pvp
parameters.description: Engagement filter: `true` for PvP only, `false` for PvE only. Omit to include both.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based pagination offset. Must be 0 or greater. Default 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Must be between 1 and 100 inclusive. Default 25.

200.description: Paged list of kill mail summaries, newest first.

get.summary: Get the full detail of a single kill mail
get.description:
Returns the complete kill mail for one engagement: victim, attackers, damage breakdown, location, and the fit (ship and modules) that was destroyed. The mail must be one of the character's own (a kill they participated in or a loss they suffered).

**Required scope:** `killmail.detail.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

parameters.name: killMailId
parameters.description: Id of a kill mail listed under `GET /v1/killmails`. Requesting a mail the character was not involved in returns 404.

200.description: Full detail for the requested kill mail.

get.description:
Returns a paged list of in-game mail headers (sender, subject, date, read/unread state) for the character. Mail bodies are not included — use `GET /v1/mail/{mailId}` to fetch a single mail body.

Defaults to the received inbox; pass `sent=true` to list mail the character has sent. Use `mailType` to filter to a single category (e.g. corporation mail, alliance mail).

**Required scope:** `mail.list.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

parameters.name: sent
parameters.description: Mailbox to list. `false` returns the received inbox (default); `true` returns mail the character has sent.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Zero-based pagination offset. Must be 0 or greater. Default 0.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size. Must be between 1 and 100 inclusive. Default 50.

parameters.name: mailType
parameters.description: Mail-category filter. 1-2 character code. Known values: `A` = player-to-player mail (e.g. correspondence between characters), `C` = construction/manufacturing notifications (e.g. "Manufacturing Run Complete"), `R` = research notifications (e.g. "Research Completed in colony: …"), `S` = system notifications (e.g. skill-training completion, daily financial reports). Default `A`.

get.summary: Get the body of a single in-game mail
get.description:
Returns the full body and header metadata for one in-game mail. The mail must belong to the character (received or sent).

**Required scope:** `mail.body.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

parameters.name: mailId
parameters.description: Id of a mail listed under `GET /v1/mail`. Must belong to the character (received or sent). Requesting a mail that is not the character's returns 404.

200.description: Full body and headers of the requested mail.

get.summary: Get the active ship's configuration and fit
get.description:
Returns the configuration of the ship the character is currently flying: hull, fitted modules, slot layout, and component-level properties.

**Required scope:** `ship.configuration.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

200.description: Active ship configuration and fitted modules.

get.summary: Get the active ship's cargo hold contents
get.description:
Returns the contents of the cargo hold(s) of the ship the character is currently flying, including item identities, quantities, and per-item properties.

**Required scope:** `ship.cargo.read`

parameters.name: X-App-Id
parameters.description: The `app_id` GUID of the calling third-party application. Must match the `app_id` claim of the bearer token — a mismatch returns 401 Unauthorized.

200.description: Cargo hold contents of the active ship.

bearer_auth.description: JWT Authorization header using the Bearer scheme. Enter your token in the text input below (without 'Bearer ' prefix).
